properties.statement:
IMPORTING AN EXPORT MATERIALISES SCHEMA DEFAULTS THE DOCUMENT NEVER CARRIED, SO A FRESHLY RESTORED GRAPH REPORTS ITSELF CHANGED AND BLOCKS THE NEXT COMMIT ON A MACHINE WHERE NOBODY HAS DESIGNED ANYTHING. music_graph, fourth pass, 2026-08-15, reflow2-mcp 0.31.0 on both sides — the run-book's own §0b restore procedure, walked on a fresh clone.

MEASURED: `--import` took 327 nodes / 939 edges; `--diff` of that same file against the store it had just built reported `design_changed: 35`, `edges_changed: 0`. ALL 35 ARE ARTIFACTS — every Artifact in the graph — each differing in exactly two properties absent from the document and present in the store: `granularity: null → atomic`, `volatility: null → stable`. The content hash moves with them, and the pre-commit gate blocks: 'COMMIT BLOCKED — the design export is behind the live design graph.'

THEIR DIAGNOSIS IS PROBABLY RIGHT AND IS A MIGRATION, NOT AN EXPORT BUG: that store was built under 0.20.0, those two Artifact fields arrived later, the original store was never backfilled — so 0.31.0's export wrote faithfully what was there and 0.31.0's import filled in what was missing. AND IT CONVERGES: exporting the restored graph and re-importing that diffs `identical: true`. One cycle, then a fixed point.

⭐⭐ THIS IS THE EXACT CLASS THE ROUND-TRIP GATE SHIPPED TODAY (PR #196) DETECTS — AND IT WILL FIRE ON THEM. `check_round_trip` compares node properties after an export→import→re-export and would report '35 node(s) came back with different properties'. THAT IS A TRUE POSITIVE BY ITS OWN DEFINITION (the document does not survive being read back unchanged) AND WILL READ AS A FAILURE ON ANY DESIGN BUILT BEFORE THOSE FIELDS EXISTED. reflow2's own design does NOT fire, because its Artifacts already carry both properties — the self-host blindness pattern for the fifth time today: the maintainer's graph cannot produce the input that breaks the consumer's.

⚠️ SO THE GATE I SHIPPED TODAY AND THIS DEFECT ARE ONE DECISION, NOT TWO. Their option (b) — exclude default-valued properties from the content hash, so materialising a default is not a change — would settle both at once. Options (a) backfill on import and open, and (c) have `--import` print what it defaulted, leave the round-trip check reporting a difference that is real but uninteresting.

THEIR FRAMING OF THE COST IS THE PART TO KEEP: 'the first thing reflow2 does on a new machine is tell an agent the design has changed when it has not, and the honest fix (refresh the export, commit it) is INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM THE DISHONEST ONE (--no-verify) unless somebody diffs it property by property first.'

NOT ESTABLISHED: how many consumer designs predate those fields; whether any other node type has the same unbackfilled shape; and whether excluding defaults from the hash would weaken the hash anywhere it matters.
